what: Kokoro-82M (onnx-community/Kokoro-82M-v1.0-ONNX) via kokoro-js and transformers.js, WebGPU backend, Chromium on Boiler (NVIDIA RTX 3060, no shader-f16). Warm second generation of a 4.9 to 5.3 s sentence; model fetched from Hugging Face for the spike.

intelligibility.transcript: The capital of France is Paris. This is a short test of on-device speech.

conclusion: fp32 on a real GPU: perfect read-back (WER 0.0) at 6.7x real time, but the model is 326 MB. q8 on WebGPU runs mostly on the CPU (0.72x).
